summary.text: Herman Hall, a Republican, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 42 to incumbent Rodneyse Bichotte Hermelyn.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Conservative Party candidate for the New York State Senate in 2014.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Hall ran for New York State Senate in 2014 as the Conservative Party candidate, losing the general election to incumbent Kevin Parker.
The Republican primary was canceled, and Hall advanced without appearing on the ballot.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Hall lost to Rodneyse Bichotte Hermelyn, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
